author: KEXP
description: Italian singer-songwriter and producer Gaia Banfi powers her craft with experimental fusions of pop and electronic sounds. Live from Trans Musicales, she joins our remote crew for a daring performance of "Seia" and more.
title: Gaia Banfi performs "Seia" and more Live on KEXP from Trans Musicales

author: KEXP
description:
